quarterly_data.signal: Reblozyl regulatory filing: on July 30 the FDA accepted the supplemental Biologics License Application for Reblozyl with concomitant janus kinase inhibitor therapy in adult patients with myelofibrosis-associated anemia receiving red blood cell transfusions, supported by results from the Phase 3 INDEPENDENCE study, and granted a PDUFA date of March 11, 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: Reblozyl sBLA accepted July 30; PDUFA March 11, 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Mezigdomide: on May 29 BMS announced positive Phase 3 SUCCESSOR-2 results, in which mezigdomide with carfilzomib and dexamethasone (MeziKd) versus carfilzomib and dexamethasone alone (Kd) in RRMM showed a clinically meaningful and statistically significant improvement in PFS, 'representing a 52% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death compared with Kd.' On July 13 the FDA accepted the New Drug Application for MeziKd in RRMM based on SUCCESSOR-2, making mezigdomide the second BMS CELMoD granted a PDUFA date this year for an RRMM indication, joining iberdomide.
quarterly_data.figure: SUCCESSOR-2: 52% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death vs Kd; NDA accepted July 13

quarterly_data.signal: Iza-bren (izalontamab brengitecan): on June 2 BMS announced with SystImmune that SystImmune's parent company Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical reported positive results from prespecified interim analyses of two Phase 3 studies, in which iza-bren achieved statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in overall survival and progression-free survival in heavily pretreated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and in recurrent or metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
quarterly_data.figure: two Phase 3 interim analyses positive on overall survival and PFS (TNBC, ESCC)

quarterly_data.signal: Camzyos regulatory status: on June 1 the FDA accepted for priority review the supplemental New Drug Application for Camzyos as a potential treatment for adolescents ages 12 to <18 years with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; the submission was based on data from the Phase 3 SCOUT-HCM trial.
quarterly_data.figure: sNDA accepted for priority review June 1

quarterly_data.signal: Pumitamig: on May 30 BMS and BioNTech SE announced interim Phase 2 data from the global Phase 2/3 ROSETTA Lung-02 trial of pumitamig plus chemotherapy in previously untreated advanced non-small cell lung cancer, which 'demonstrated robust anti-tumor activity with high response rates observed in both non-squamous and squamous NSCLC and at each PD-L1 expression level.' The results deck lists pumitamig as initiating a Phase 2 novel combination study with imzokitug.

Business development outside the AI partnerships: in May 2026 BMS entered into global strategic collaboration and licensing agreements with Hengrui Pharma to advance a portfolio of 13 early-stage programs in oncology, hematology and immunology, which the release says furthers BMS's efforts to accelerate early-stage clinical development.

Pipeline data calendar beyond 2026 in the Q2 2026 results deck. New molecular entity registrational data in 2027: golcadomide high-risk 1L LBCL (GOLSEEK-1), milvexian AF (LIBREXIA-AF1) and zola-cel SLE (Breakfree-SLE); in 2028: atigotatug + nivolumab 1L ES-SCLC (TIGOS), iza-bren 1L TNBC (IZABRIGHT-Breast01) and pumitamig 1L ES-SCLC (ROSETTA-Lung-012). Life-cycle pivotal data in 2027: admilparant PPF (ALOFT-PPF), Cobenfy AD psychosis (ADEPT), Cobenfy bipolar-I (BALSAM-1 & 2), mezigdomide RRMM (SUCCESSOR-1) and Sotyktu Sjogren's disease (POETYK SjS-1); in 2028: arlo-cel 2-4L MM (QUINTESSENTIAL-2), Cobenfy AD agitation (ADAGIO-2) and AD cognition (MINDSET-1 & 2), Cobenfy adjunctive bipolar-1 (BALSAM-4), golcadomide 2L+ FL (GOLSEEK-4), iza-bren EGFRm NSCLC (IZABRIGHT-Lung01), Krazati 1L NSCLC (KRYSTAL-4 and KRYSTAL-7), Reblozyl 1L NTD MDS-associated anemia (ELEMENT) and zola-cel SSc (Breakfree-SSc). Early-stage data due in 2027 include moponetug (anti-MTBR-tau) in Alzheimer's disease (TargetTau-1) and irafamdastat in AD agitation and MS spasticity.
quarterly_data.figure: registrational and pivotal readouts scheduled for 2027 and 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Legacy portfolio erosion detail in the Q2 2026 release and deck: Revlimid revenue fell 49% to $425 million and Pomalyst/Imnovid fell 71% to $204 million; the deck notes that in the U.S. generic lenalidomide products are no longer volume-limited as of January 31, 2026 and generic pomalidomide entered in March of 2026. The deck also states that Opdivo's Q2 2026 global sales reflect a ~$200M sequential inventory build.
quarterly_data.figure: Revlimid $425 million (-49%); Pomalyst/Imnovid $204 million (-71%); Opdivo ~$200M sequential inventory build
